sources.title: ConflictRAG: Detecting and Resolving Knowledge Conflicts in Retrieval Augmented Generation
sources.novelty_action: Treat contradiction and conflict detection as crowded; preserve novelty only for controlled research QA combinations with authority hierarchy, lifecycle, temporal snapshot, insufficiency, and conclusion-support labels.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Conflicting Evidence
sources.novelty_action: Do not claim conflict resolution alone. Use this as evidence that hard-grounded research needs explicit conflict provenance and answerability rubrics.

sources.title: What Should I Cite? A RAG Benchmark for Academic Citation Prediction
overlap: citation supports fact but not conclusion
sources.novelty_action: Frame citation-overreach as conclusion-support semantics, not as citation generation or citation recall.

sources.title: Sufficient Context: A New Lens on Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems
sources.novelty_action: Keep abstention claims narrow; require hard-grounded items to distinguish insufficient evidence from wrong citation use and conclusion overreach.

sources.title: MuDABench: A Benchmark for Multi-Document Analytical QA
sources.novelty_action: Avoid claiming atypical-document RAG novelty; position the benchmark around cross-category failure mechanisms.

sources.title: Towards Global Retrieval Augmented Generation: A Benchmark for Global QA
sources.novelty_action: Treat large-scale synthesis as adjacent; require contribution language to emphasize evidence semantics and controlled failure categories.

sources.title: RAGChecker: A Fine-grained Framework for Diagnosing Retrieval-Augmented Generation
sources.novelty_action: Cite diagnostic metric work separately from benchmark construction; do not claim fine-grained RAG diagnosis as novel.

sources.title: RAGBench: Explainable Benchmark for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
sources.novelty_action: Use as older background for retrieval/context selection, not as a central novelty risk.

sources.title: LIT-RAGBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models as Integrated Tabular and Textual Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
sources.novelty_action: Cite as a high-pressure integration and abstention comparator; preserve novelty only for the full hard-grounded research taxonomy and HF-derived lifecycle/authority/citation-overreach construction.

sources.title: Is This Snippet Worth Citing? Towards Evidence Force in Cited-RAG
overlap: citation supports fact but not conclusion
sources.novelty_action: Treat evidence-force and citation-worthiness as crowded; narrow citation-overreach claims to conclusion-level support in multi-document research QA.

sources.title: T2-RAGBench: Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Text-and-Table Data
sources.novelty_action: Cite as a text-table RAG benchmark and avoid claiming table-text reasoning novelty except as one category in the broader hard-grounded research QA failure suite.
